text: Turn off every light. Your phone still knows your face.
sub: Turn off every light. Your phone still knows your face.

text: How? It never needed your light. It brings its own.
sub: How? It never needed your light. It brings its own.

text: At the top of the screen, there are three tiny parts. A flood light, a dot projector, and a camera.
sub: At the top of the screen, there are three tiny parts. A flood light, a dot projector, and a camera.

text: All three work in infrared. Light just past red, which your eyes can't see.
sub: All three work in infrared. Light just past red, which your eyes can't see.

text: First, the flood light washes your face in infrared. Like a flash you can't see.
asr: First, the floodlight washes your face in infrared, like a flash you can't see.
sub: First, the flood light washes your face in infrared. Like a flash you can't see.

text: The camera takes a picture, in the dark.
sub: The camera takes a picture, in the dark.

text: But a picture can be fooled. So the projector fires more than thirty thousand dots.
asr: But a picture can be fooled, so the projector fires more than 30,000 dots.
sub: But a picture can be fooled. So the projector fires more than 30,000 dots.

text: On a flat wall, the dots land in a grid. On a face, they bend. Around your nose, your eyes, your cheeks.
sub: On a flat wall, the dots land in a grid. On a face, they bend. Around your nose, your eyes, your cheeks.

text: The camera measures how far each dot moved, and turns it into depth. A three D map of your face.
asr: The camera measures how far each dot moved and turns it into depth, a 3D map of your face.
sub: The camera measures how far each dot moved, and turns it into depth. A 3D map of your face.

text: A printed photo is flat. Its dots don't bend. No depth, no unlock.
sub: A printed photo is flat. Its dots don't bend. No depth, no unlock.

text: Your map matches the one stored inside the phone. And it opens.
sub: Your map matches the one stored inside the phone. And it opens.

text: In the dark, your phone was lighting you up the whole time. You just couldn't see it.
sub: In the dark, your phone was lighting you up the whole time. You just couldn't see it.
